directional_quality.instructions: Judge only whether the supplied decision-time execution state is supportive, adverse, or insufficient for the already-supplied candidate direction. Do not choose an action, size, threshold, risk limit, or use future information.

criteria.supportive: Decision-time evidence is coherent with the supplied candidate direction.
criteria.adverse: Decision-time evidence materially argues against the supplied candidate direction.
criteria.unclear: The supplied decision-time evidence is insufficient or mixed.

execution_quality.instructions: Judge only the execution quality visible in the supplied decision-time state. Do not choose an action, size, threshold, or risk limit.

criteria.good: The supplied decision-time market state supports clean execution quality.
criteria.poor: The supplied decision-time market state shows materially poor execution quality.
criteria.unclear: Execution quality cannot be established from the supplied state.

toxic_flow.instructions: Judge only whether the supplied decision-time state shows evidence consistent with toxic or adverse flow. Do not use any post-decision information.

criteria.present: Decision-time evidence is consistent with materially toxic or adverse flow.
criteria.absent: Decision-time evidence does not show materially toxic or adverse flow.
criteria.unclear: The supplied decision-time state is insufficient or mixed.
